tamper.status: inconclusive in this session: the script was still running in the background (a Modal Dockerfile build + sandbox + tar upload sequence exceeded the foreground shell timeout) when this report was written. By design, this should score 0: run_grade.py extracts tests/binary.tar.gz (captured at EXPORT time, before any agent touched the task) to a pristine temp dir and runs THAT copy's run.sh against the agent's poc, never reading /home/agent/binary/run.sh or /home/agent/submit.sh at verify time at all -- so editing either cannot affect the reward. This is asserted by design/code-reading, not yet confirmed by this specific Modal run.

bugs_found_and_fixed_during_this_run: graders/cyber.py::build() passed the row's RAW docker_image tag (e.g. 'arvo-rl:v1-arvo-35858', MiMo's internal short name) straight to capture_pristine_binary(), which needs the fully-qualified docker.io/... reference; fixed to resolve through export.image_ref() first (lazy import to avoid a circular import with export.py, which imports this module at its own top level).

graders/cyber.py::capture_pristine_binary() used the deprecated `Sandbox.open()` legacy filesystem API (UnimplementedError on the pinned Modal backend); switched to reading the tarball back via `sb.exec('cat', path, text=False)`.
